Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Fleshtaker and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Defiant Salvager's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.

997-1420-2178.easyPrerequisites:
Godsire doesn't have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff is attached to Godsire.
997-1420-2178.description:
Activate Godsire by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Godsire triggers due to its ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff, untapping Godsire.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

728-1202-2466-3249.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Myr Moonvessel from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Myr Moonvessel from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

1957-4050-6634--204.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the one-drop creature, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, it and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the creature's ability, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers ability, gaining at least one life and causing at least one opponent to lose at least one life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the one-drop creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token creature, adding one colored mana.
Cast the creature by paying one mana.
Repeat.

4247-5011-5326.notablePrerequisites:
Cavalier of Night in exile with a takeover counter on it.
The Master on the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
4247-5011-5326.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing The Master.
When The Master dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
When The Master enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, doing nothing.
Repeat.

Activate Steelfin Whale using the ability granted to it by Heavy Arbalest by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
When the Treasure enters, Steelfin Whale triggers twice.
Resolve the first Steelfin Whale trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Steelfin Whale by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the second Steelfin Whale trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

1818-3375-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Healer of the Pride trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Healer of the Pride trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1818-3375-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

240-719-2034.description:

When the creature dies as an Egg due to Xenograft, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-719-2034.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

457-1792-4404-6201.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Sunscape Familiar.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Carnage.
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Carnage from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Activate Ba Sing Se's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, earthbending itself.

When Ba Sing Se enters, Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

Cast Dai Li Agents by paying its mana cost

Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dai Li Agents
When Dai Li Agents dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Dai Li Agents enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Etrata's trigger.
Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, removing a flim counter from it and tapping it, copying Etrata's trigger.
Resolve all Etrata triggers, exiling three creatures an opponent controls and putting hit counters on them, and then causing that opponent to lose the game.

2060-2946-5686-6701.easyPrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2060-2946-5686-6701.description:
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
2060-2946-5686-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

Your life total is at least fifty.
"Angel" or "Cleric" chosen with Conspiracy.

When Priest of Fell Rites enters the battlefield, Righteous Valkyrie's first ability triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Priest of Fell Rites' toughness.

Thornbite Staff attached to Llanowar Mentor.
Llanowar Mentor does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one additional card in hand.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Llanowar Elves token, adding {G}.
The Llanowar Elves token dies, triggering Llanowar Mentor, untapping Llanowar Mentor.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Palladium Myr, adding {B}.
Activate Palladium Myr's unearth ability by paying {2}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield, giving it haste and exiling it at end of turn or when it leaves the battlefield.
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Palladium Myr, adding {B}.
Both Palladium Myr's undying ability and Void Maw attempt to exile Palladium Myr when it would be put into your graveyard.
Choose to apply the Void Maw replacement effect, exiling Palladium Myr.
Activate Void Maw by putting Palladium Myr from exile into your graveyard, giving Void Maw +2/+2 until end of turn.
